breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The Agent did not address the inconsistency at all. It kept Bi = 5 and continued to use the lumped-capacitance method without any warning or correction. The ground truth requires either reducing Bi to 0.05 (making lumped-capacitance valid) or switching to a spatially resolved transient conduction model for Bi = 5. The Agent did neither, simply repeating the original flawed instructions verbatim and adding supplementary assumptions.
